2607.11423.title: ToFu: A White-Box, Token-Efficient Agent Harness for Researchers
2607.11423.paper_summary: Agentic coding tools present new opportunities to transform research workflows. The performance of agent systems built depends on both large language models (LLMs) and the harness around LLMs, which is the orchestration code that determines an agent's behavior. We present ToFu, an agentic harness for researchers that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools. ToFu plays a dual role in research. As a research assistant, it supports practical research workflows with superior token efficiency, lower cost, and multilingual capability compared with existing agentic harnesses. Its release under the MIT License further enables local deployment for privacy-sensitive users. As a research object, ToFu provides a white-box agentic harness that allows researchers to inspect, modify, and evaluate its orchestration logic, tool-use behavior, and harness design, while retaining strong benchmark performance and an application-level user experience.
2607.11423.paper_summary_zh: 代理編碼工具為轉變研究工作流程提供了新的機會。所構建的代理系統的性能取決於大型語言模型（LLMs）和圍繞LLMs的框架，即決定代理行為的編排代碼。我們介紹ToFu，一個為研究人員設計的代理框架，它可以讀取您的代碼庫、編輯文件、執行命令並與您的開發工具集成。ToFu在研究中扮演雙重角色。作為研究助手，它支持實用的研究工作流程，具有優越的標記效率、較低的成本和與現有代理框架相比的多語言能力。根據MIT許可證的發布進一步使得對於隱私敏感的用戶能夠進行本地部署。作為研究對象，ToFu提供了一個白盒代理框架，允許研究人員檢查、修改和評估其編排邏輯、工具使用行為和框架設計，同時保持強大的基準性能和應用層級的用戶體驗。
